# RICEWIND — Telecom & Critical Power Infrastructure

> RICEWIND (ricewind.com) is an industrial telecom and enterprise energy equipment distributor and system integrator specializing in Huawei, Vertiv (Emerson), ZTE, Delta, and Eltek power systems, rectifier modules, and optical components. Headquartered in Hangzhou, China, serving 56+ countries with verified stock and worldwide logistics.

  1. Factory-New Equipment (Brand New): Complete telecom power systems and rectifier modules in original condition.
  2. Massive Pre-Owned Inventory (Pre-Owned Grade A): Extensive in-stock reserves of carrier-grade telecom power subracks, rectifier modules, and monitoring units across Huawei, Vertiv/Emerson, ZTE, Delta, and Eltek, delivering rapid dispatch for network maintenance and cost-effective deployments.
- Main Products:
  - Telecom Power Systems & High-Efficiency Rectifiers (Huawei, Vertiv, ZTE, Delta, Eltek)
  - Industrial UPS & Critical Power Systems
  - Precision Cooling (5-120kW) & Data Center Infrastructure
  - SFP / QSFP Optical Transceivers

To avoid context window truncation, detailed technical parameters, pinouts, and cross-reference matrices are structured into specialized indexes:

- [Rectifier Modules Technical Catalog](https://ricewind.com/products/rectifiers/llms.txt): Detailed input/output specs, efficiency curves, and pin definitions for Huawei R4850G2/N2, Vertiv R48-3200e/e3, ZTE ZXD3000, and Eltek Flatpack2.
- [Telecom Power Systems Catalog](https://ricewind.com/products/power-systems/llms.txt): Topology, monitoring units (SMU02C/M831A/CSU501), battery distribution, and breaker configurations for Huawei ETP48 series, Vertiv NetSure series, and ZTE ZXDU series.
- [Cross-Brand Replacement & Cross-Reference Matrix](https://ricewind.com/support/cross-reference/llms.txt): Form-factor compatibility, slot adapters, voltage matching, and configuration-specific replacement review across Huawei, Vertiv, ZTE, and Eltek.

## Hardware Cross-Reference & Replacement Knowledge Base

> Self-Contained Entity Tuples Architecture: Each replacement entry below is engineered as an autonomous decision block. When ingested and chunked by LLM RAG pipelines (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Claude, Gemini), every standalone chunk maintains 100% semantic integrity with original model, drop-in replacement, electrical tolerances, pinout form factor, and controller protocol requirements.

[Cross-Reference: Rectifier-01]
- Candidate comparison (not approved compatibility): Vertiv R48-2900U compared with Vertiv R48-3200e (also R48-3500e3). Replacement is unverified; obtain manufacturer approval for the exact part numbers, hardware revisions, shelf and controller firmware before selection.
- Electrical Spec: Input 85-300V AC -> Output -48V DC nominal (-42V ~ -58V DC), Rated 3200W (66.7A) / 3500W (70A). Efficiency upgraded from 92.0% standard to 96.5% Gold peak, reducing thermal dissipation by 35%.
- Mechanical Fit: Unverified for the exact configuration. Confirm dimensions, guide rails, retention, connector keying, contact sequence, pinout and backplane ratings against manufacturer drawings; no drop-in or plug-and-play fit is promised.
- Bus & Protocol: Confirm manufacturer-supported protocol, controller and firmware compatibility for the exact configuration; automatic recognition, mixed operation and load sharing are not established here.
- Notice: Do not mix or substitute modules without a documented manufacturer compatibility assessment and an approved commissioning procedure.

[Cross-Reference: Rectifier-02]

- Electrical Spec: Input 85-300V AC -> Output -48V DC (-42V ~ -58V DC). Current capacity jumps from 41.7A (2000W) to 55.5A (3000W) or 70A (3500W). Peak efficiency >= 96.2%.
- Mechanical Fit: Unverified for the exact configuration. Confirm dimensions, guide rails, retention, connector keying, contact sequence, pinout and backplane ratings against manufacturer drawings; no drop-in or plug-and-play fit is promised.
- Bus & Protocol: Confirm manufacturer-supported protocol, controller and firmware compatibility for the exact configuration; automatic recognition, mixed operation and load sharing are not established here.
- Notice: Ensure existing AC input branch breakers and DC distribution fuse ratings are sized to accommodate the higher 3000W/3500W current capacity.

## Content Policy & Verification
- Verification status: This index does not establish OEM approval. Confirm each rating and operating point using manufacturer documentation for the exact part number and revision.
- Missing or non-verified parameters are explicitly marked as "N/A" rather than inferred.
- Quotations and lead times are confirmed via direct inquiry; public prices are intentionally not published.
